title: Do I have to service air conditioners that I dont use?

title: What are the signs that my AC isn’t working properly?
desc: The most obvious sign that your air conditioner isnt working is that the temperature in your home isn’t cooling. If you notice warm air coming from vents or wake up sweating in the middle of the night, something is likely wrong with your AC system. Strange noises and loud fans may also indicate that something is wrong with the system.

title: Why is my air conditioner not cooling?
desc: Several factors can contribute to your air conditioner not cooling effectively. It could be due to a dirty or clogged filter, refrigerant issues, a malfunctioning thermostat, or even problems with the compressor. Our experienced technicians can diagnose and fix the issue to restore your AC’s cooling performance.

title: How many times does AC need to be serviced?
desc: Regular AC maintenance is essential to ensure its optimal performance and longevity. We recommend having your AC serviced at least once a year to keep it in top shape. However, in particularly dusty or hot environments, more frequent servicing may be required to prevent issues.

title: How do I know if my AC needs to be serviced?
desc: Some signs that indicate your AC may need servicing include reduced cooling efficiency, strange noises, unusual odors, or a sudden increase in energy consumption. If you notice any of these issues, it’s a good time to schedule a service to prevent further damage.

title: How do I check my AC cooling?
desc:
To check your AC’s cooling, follow these simple steps:
- Set the thermostat to a lower temperature than the current room temperature.
- Place your hand near the supply air vent to feel if cool air is coming out.
- Use a thermometer to measure the air temperature from the supply air vent. It should be significantly cooler than the room temperature.
- If you notice that the air isn’t cooling as it should, or theres a lack of airflow, its a clear indicator that your AC might need servicing. Please contact us, and well be happy to assist you in resolving the issue
